functions.iter_native_records(root, entity): iterator (native_dict, pathlib.Path), sorted stable IDs; four entity names
functions.iter_legacy_records(root, table): iterator (exact_v2_dict, native_path), nine legacy names; audio reads only schema.json/assets.jsonl; compatibility version adapter
functions.load_legacy_record(root, record_id): dict; single v3 document and necessary hash/artifact/annotation dependencies only
functions.migrate_v2(source_root, destination_root: dict report; destination data must not exist; source untouched; lightweight wrapper
functions.replace_legacy_records(root, table, rows: dict report; one complete legacy table replacement, other tables preserved, v3 only; rows dict or (dict,path)
functions.write_legacy_dataset(root, tables): dict report; complete nine-table mapping (missing empty), iterable values consumed once; unknown fields fail before writes; rejects legacy destination files; atomic per-file os.replace detaches hardlinks
functions.write_legacy_updates(root, updates): list[pathlib.Path] relative to root, changed paths; upsert all table batches once, omitted IDs preserved

entities.items: data/items.jsonl merges original items and collections; original IDs/kinds
entities.assets: data/assets.jsonl; audio/archive/review_document/html; artifacts are real UTF8 files

native_fields.common: No per-record schema_version. id/kind and retained semantic fields; _legacy={table,keys,metadata_aliases?,derived?,null_fields?}; keys lists exact original root key presence; no original row/raw dump; original kind lives only in row.kind
native_fields.metadata_aliases: map removed metadata key -> retained metadata key, identical canonical JSON only (types significant); $title/$content_sha256/$language/$model restores [root_value]. created/ctime/author never treated as pubdate/uploader
native_fields.documents: inputs=[{role,target_id}], blocks=[{range:[start,end] XOR literal:string, original non-index/text fields, input_text_ref? or input_text, index_absent?:true}]; ranges Unicode codepoints half-open, sequential monotone; index=array position
native_fields.input_roles: item:item_id|item_ids, audio:audio_ids, transcript:transcript_ids, derived_from:derived_from_id, input_units_from:input_units_from_id, article_item:article_item_ids; artifact inputs role review_document_markdown|html
native_fields.input_text_ref: {target_id,content_sha256,source,range:[start,end]}; source=text uses upstream.text; segments/segments_space/segments_newline use upstream blocks text joined with empty/space/newline; input_units uses target.input_units.base.segments text joined empty. Non-snapshot digest is recomputed legacy transcript payload hash (and checked against stored content_sha256); snapshot digest is canonical JSON SHA256(base). Only unique substring in unique source document is referenced; ambiguous input remains original input_text
native_fields.input_units: original immutable snapshot object retained, including source text/timing/quality; never overwritten by current transcript
native_fields.assets: audio item_ids -> inputs role item; downloads[].archive -> archive_id (z- + canonical JSON SHA256 archive object). archive asset retains name/size_bytes/sha256/url. review_document/html asset {id:x-digest,kind,sha256,size_bytes,local_path:data/artifacts/<utf8-byte-sha256>.md|html}; bytes UTF8 and line endings exact; JSON hashes are distinct
native_fields.annotations: targets ordered as original item then edited IDs; {role:item|applies_to|revision,target_id,confirmation_index?}; confirmation_index original index of annotation.id in target document confirmation_ids; revision marks applicable document having derived_from input; no confirmation IDs in documents except presence key name
native_fields.derived: _legacy.derived list supports members.position (index+1), paragraphs_match_text ('\n\n'.join(paragraph text).strip()==text.strip()), quality.timing_issues (records.find_timestamp_issues algorithm, independently reimplemented Decimal). Remove only when exact equality to calculated value; historical disagreement stays inline. No other quality judgments inferred
native_fields.projection: schema_version=2 if present in _legacy.keys; kind unchanged; reconstruct blocks/index/input_text; reverse inputs/targets; confirmation_ids from annotation.id sorted target.confirmation_index; resolve artifacts/archive; derive declared fields; restore exact metadata aliases; final filter _legacy.keys preserves absence/null

failure: unknown legacy root/block/download/archive or native fields explicitly fail; no silent loss; missing refs/invalid hashes fail native validation
